_status: Screening assumptions for the 2026 Tel Aviv / Ramat Gan pilot. Every money figure is an editable assumption in ILS, not a quote. Replace with installer quotes and the building's actual tariff before any decision.

bipv.label: BIPV facade cladding
bipv.description: Rigid glass-glass modules that replace part of the opaque facade cladding (rear-ventilated rainscreen).
bipv._renewalCredit: Cladding not bought when BIPV replaces it during a planned facade renewal: [conservative, central, optimistic].

flexible.label: Flexible thin-film
flexible.description: Lightweight modules on polymer or metal substrates, bonded to facade panels or flat roofs.

bapv.label: BAPV roof racking
bapv.description: Conventional rigid modules on a tilted rack on the roof or technical floor.

louvres.label: Solar shading louvres
louvres.description: PV blades above or in front of windows that shade glazing and generate electricity.
louvres._renewalCredit: Conventional external shading not bought when the renewal includes shading anyway.

economics._order: Triples are [conservative, central, optimistic] except where the cost order makes the first value the worst (CAPEX/OPEX: [low, mid, high] → conservative uses high).

feasibility._highRiseM: Height above which combustible facade products are treated as a blocking fire issue. Set from current Israeli fire regulations with a fire engineer; 29 m is a placeholder.
